resources.string: Cannot open the address: no browser installed.
The UPnP description was not fetched (address outside the own subnet or not the sender, not http, or no answer within 2 s).
Identification did not finish, so mDNS and UPnP are unknown.
mDNS and UPnP are checked after a completed device search.

Liveness: ICMP ping; where the system or a VPN does not allow ICMP, TCP probes to ports 80, 443, 22 and 445 (a refused connection counts too). Names: NetBIOS, mDNS (.local, Apple, Linux/Avahi, printers) and reverse DNS (PTR), shown in this order; a device without a name is shown by its IP address. After a completed search, live devices are also asked over mDNS (names and services) and SSDP/UPnP (name, manufacturer, model); a UPnP description is fetched only from the device\'s own address in the own subnet. Android 10 and newer does not give apps the MAC address or network card vendor of other devices. Only the current Wi-Fi subnet is searched, at most a /24.
